# Express Legal Funding

> Express Legal Funding provides risk-free, non-recourse pre-settlement funding and lawsuit cash advances for personal injury plaintiffs nationwide.

Based in Plano, Texas, Express Legal Funding specializes in fast pre-settlement funding for various injury claim types including car accidents, personal injury, slip and fall, and maritime worker cases. The company operates 24/7 and serves plaintiffs across multiple states with non-recourse advances that require no repayment if the case is lost.
